provenance.source: Stellar mainnet through https://mainnet.sorobanrpc.com, 25 November 2026, ledgers 65662739-65662740 (stellar-rpc 30.0.1, stellar-core 30.0.0, protocol 30)
provenance.method: The wallet's own WalletNetwork (mainnet profile, operator fee payer) ran assertNetwork, ledgerClock, requireCode for the pinned account and WebAuthn verifier Wasm, payerAccount and diagnosticEvents through a fetch that recorded each JSON-RPC request and response. Read-only: getNetwork, getLatestLedger, getLedgerEntries and one simulateTransaction; nothing was signed or sent.
provenance.fee_payer: GA7TO5KLTANU4HRWX4MSVSV6U3RELFQEVYCRVCPKPDAYOXCJKJ45ANXD, the throwaway key whose Ed25519 seed is SHA-256 of 'ozpb-wallet-mainnet-rpc-fixture': anyone can derive it, so it must never be funded. It had no mainnet account.
provenance.note: Each response is as the endpoint returned it, keyed by its request, with one change: getLatestLedger's metadataXdr (about 3 MB of ledger close meta, which the wallet does not read) is replaced by a LedgerCloseMeta v0 holding only that ledger's own header and no transactions, so the SDK still parses the response. Its headerXdr, unchanged, still hashes to its id. Repeated identical requests are recorded once.
